info.name: LMS Security Testing – OWASP + Paymob + IDOR
info.description:
## LMS Security Testing Collection

Tests OWASP Top 10, Paymob Webhook HMAC, and IDOR vulnerabilities.

### Prerequisites
1. Backend running: `cd backend && npm run start:dev`
2. Redis running: `docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.yml up -d redis`
3. Test users created via `setup-production-users.js`
4. Update `firebaseApiKey` variable with your Firebase project's API key

### Test Accounts
| Role | Email | Password |
|------|-------|----------|
| Admin | admin1@test.com | password123 |
| Instructor | instructor@test.com | password123 |
| Student 1 | student1@test.com | password123 |
| Student 2 | student2@test.com | password123 |

### Run Order
00 → 01 → 02 → 03 → 04 → 05 → 06 → 07

### Expected Results
- ✅ PASS = Request was correctly rejected (401/403/400)
- ❌ FAIL = Request succeeded when it shouldn't have

item.name: 03 – Paymob Webhook HMAC Verification
item.description:
Test that the Paymob webhook endpoint verifies HMAC signatures.
Expected: Fake/invalid HMAC should be rejected with 401.

request.description:

item.name: 04 – IDOR (Quiz Attempt Ownership)

Test that Student A cannot act on Student B's quiz attempt by swapping the attempt ID.
Expected: all attack requests should return 403 Forbidden.
